study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual deviations from normative models of brain structure in a large cross-sectional schizophrenia cohort

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Quantile regression used to estimate percentile curves for FA and CT.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Quantile regression was used to determine percentile curves for each cortical region and each white matter tract.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Tract-averaged fractional anisotropy and regional cortical thickness.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: normative percentiles of variation in fractional anisotropy (FA) and cortical thickness (CT) were established using diffusion-weighted and structural MRI from healthy adults

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex with optional age-squared and sex-by-age interaction terms; acquisition site included as a confound.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: given certain explanatory variables (e.g., age and sex) ... Ci encapsulates nuisance confounds, including acquisition site. The sex-by-age interaction (β3) and the nonlinear age-squared term (β4) were only included when justified by the Bayesian information criteria.
